subject: Emerald Health renewal — request for exception / preservation package
messages:
From: K. Santos <k.santos@emeraldhealth.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Apr 2029 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Contract renewal concerns — Emerald Health

Irene,

We're coming up on our renewal and I need to be direct — budget for next fiscal year is significantly constrained. We run a number of mission-critical pipelines on Redwood, but procurement is pushing for a 20–30% reduction across vendors.

Before we go to competitive RFP, can you confirm if Redwood can (a) offer a short-term credit to bridge us through Q3, (b) provide a term reset to align invoicing with our new fiscal cadence, and (c) accommodate a basic SLA uplift or a partial uptime credit if we see any regression?

Attached is a short internal risk assessment so you can see our cost targets (Q2_Renewal_Risk_Assessment.pdf). Happy to hop on a call — Emily (CFO) is cc'd.

Thanks,
Katherine Santos
Head of Procurement, Emerald Health
K. Santos <k.santos@emeraldhealth.com>
Attachment: Q2_Renewal_Risk_Assessment.pdf

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Apr 2029 14:33:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Emerald Health renewal — request for exception / preservation package

Irene,

Thanks for flagging. Quick guidance from my side: we want to preserve this account but need a clear, timeboxed concession that minimizes long-term ARR impact. Please prepare two discrete options with estimated NPV/one-time hit and operational commitments:

- Option 1 (Value preservation): one-time credit covering Q3 usage up to $45,000 + 6-month term reset (no change to list pricing thereafter). No SLA changes.
- Option 2 (Service continuity): 10% annual discount for the first 12 months + SLA uplift to 99.9% for the next contract year and a one-time 2-month service credit if SLA not met.

Max approval authority from my side for a concession without Board sign-off is a 15% ARR-equivalent discount or $60k one-time credit; anything larger needs executive sign-off and finance review. Include deployment metrics and churn risk notes.

Vivek
VP, Sales — Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

P.S. Laura — please include potential impacts to the Dedicated pool quotas in the options.

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: K. Santos <k.santos@emeraldhealth.com>
Cc: Emily Rhodes <emily.rhodes@emeraldhealth.com>, procurement@emeraldhealth.com
Date: Mon, 15 Apr 2029 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Preservation package proposal — Emerald Health renewal (two options)

Katherine / Emily — thanks for the conversation last week. Per our internal review, Redwood can move forward with a preservation package. Below are two formal options — pick the one that best matches Emerald's priorities and we'll circulate a one-page addendum for signatures.

Option A — Short bridge credit (lower immediate cash impact)
- One-time credit: up to $45,000 applied pro rata across Q3 invoices
- Term reset: shift renewal to Jan 1, 2030 (6-month extension from original)
- No change to standard SLA
- Internal impact: estimated one-time ARR hit of $45k; no ongoing discount

Option B — Service continuity (preferred for operational stability)
- 10% discount on subscription ARR for the first 12 months of the renewed term
- SLA uplift: target 99.9% (formal SLA addendum) and a 2-month service credit if SLA < 99.9% in the first 12 months
- Term reset: shift to Jan 1, 2030 (12-month alignment)
- Internal impact: estimated ARR reduction of ~10% for 12 months; Vivek has authority up to 15% without further exec sign-off

Attachments: Emerald_Save_Package_v1.pdf (one-page summary of both options), budget_summary.xlsx (from earlier)

If Emerald approves Option B, we can prepare a concise addendum and DocuSign package — we'll supply a redline for legal to accept. Please indicate preferred option and whether procurement wants a consolidated PO or staged invoicing.

Thanks,
Irene Choi
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 415-555-9234
Attachments: Emerald_Save_Package_v1.pdf, budget_summary.xlsx

From: Emily Rhodes <emily.rhodes@emeraldhealth.com>

Subject: Re: Preservation package proposal — Emerald Health renewal (two options)

Irene — thanks for the quick turnaround and for being flexible. After internal review Emerald accepts Option B (10% first-year discount + SLA addendum + term realignment). Procurement would like a single addendum and our standard PO to attach.

Can you send the DocuSign link and the one-page addendum we can sign this week? Also please include the billing contact and final invoicing schedule so I can get the PO routed.
